purpose: Execute full complaint intake use case.
action_or_input: Submit complaint with title 'AC not cooling', location 'Room 201'.
expected_result: HTTP 201, complaint created, auto-assigned, audit log written.

purpose: Engineer prepares and submits cost and time estimate.
action_or_input: Create estimate with materials=5000, labor=2000, time=3 days.
expected_result: HTTP 200/201, complaint status ASSESSED, estimate PENDING_APPROVAL.

purpose: Department Head reviews and approves mid-range estimate after committee.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, estimate status APPROVED, complaint ESTIMATE_APPROVED.

purpose: Department Head rejects mid-range estimate with reason.
expected_result: HTTP 200 OK, estimate status REJECTED, reason persisted.
